name: Nanaka
message: 「What did you have for breakfast this morning?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're full of energy right from the morning」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Compared to that, look at this guy」
Aah, there's static in my vision...

name: Nanaka
message: 「At a 45-degree angle, keeping the core steady, snap your wrist and bring your arm down swiftly」

name: Misa
message: 「Right back at you, hmph! Sorry, but I'll be heading on ahead!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「--Wait, heyyy! Why are you running too, Synn!?」

name: Synn
message: 「M-My body just moved on its own」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huff... puff... We weren't even going to be late...」

name: Misa
message: 「Huff, puff. Come on, time for the meeting...」

name: Ria
message: 「No, no, Synn-kun. You shouldn't chug it all at once~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please have this water packed with plenty of mustard」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I thought it would wake you right up, though」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on, quit fooling around. We don't have much time, so let's get started already」

name: Ria
message: 「'How cruel! So it was all just a game to you...'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um. We're talking about the new project, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Right. I've summarized the main points, so take a look at this」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, while you're at it, check mine too」

name: Ria
message: 「Amazing. Even though we just talked about it yesterday, you both put together solid summaries」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Sakura-kun. What do you mean, 'while you're at it'」

name: Misa
message: 「Did you only write something half-hearted on the side?」

name: Misa
message: 「No matter when or where, it's always a serious match between us. Don't you forget that」

name: Synn
message: 「A-All right. I put my heart and soul into this, so please read it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really care about winning, don't you, Vice President~」
Reading through both proposals, what they had each written was almost identical.

name: Nanaka
message: 「If I had to point out a difference, it's that Misa's is three and a half pages, while Synn's is three pages flat」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, keeping writing short and concise is actually harder, you know~」

name: Ria
message: 「Quality over quantity, right? Though I don't think Misa-chan's is bad quality either」

name: Misa
message: 「A-Anyway, that makes this match a draw!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then how about we try blending both of ours together?」
Their banter continued until the warning bell rang.
